coverage.note: Sessions, records, active days and the streak are read from the durable activity database and cover 2026-03-08 through 2026-10-04 (UTC days). The database started recording on 2026-07-07. From before that date it holds only the sessions whose logs were still on disk that day, so the earlier months are incomplete and nothing before 2026-03-08 is included.

definitions.totalSessions: Claude Code session logs in the record. Subagent logs are not counted.
definitions.totalMessages: Transcript records in those sessions: a prompt, a tool result, or one content block of a model reply. Not a count of messages somebody typed.
definitions.activeDays: Days with at least one transcript record.
definitions.streak: Consecutive active days ending today or yesterday, as of 2026-10-04. 0 when the last active day is older.
